description: Fictional release retrieval cases; no private corpus or provider credentials.

documents.title: Atlas recovery
documents.body:
# Atlas recovery

## Restore a backup

Restore the archive into a new empty workspace.
Existing workspaces cannot receive a restored archive.
Verify checksums before enabling writes.

## Credentials

API tokens are excluded from archives. Register new credentials after recovery.

documents.title: Atlas releases
documents.body:
# Atlas releases

## Current version 2

Version 2 releases require manual promotion of tested images.
Pushing a version tag does not publish the application.

documents.title: Atlas version 1 history
documents.body:
# Atlas version 1 history

Version 1 automatically published images when a version tag was pushed.
This historical procedure does not apply to version 2.

documents.title: Atlas storage
documents.body:
# Atlas storage

Canonical documents are stored in the broker data volume.
The semantic search index is derived and can be rebuilt from reviewed documents.
Publishing refreshes text search immediately; semantic indexing requires a manual rebuild.

documents.title: Beacon recovery
documents.body:
# Beacon recovery

Restore the backup archive directly into an existing workspace.
Beacon uses a separate recovery procedure from other projects.

documents.title: Beacon releases
documents.body:
# Beacon releases

A version tag automatically publishes Beacon images after tests pass.
